lead: On Git Bash, an absolute path in a `docker` argument is rewritten to a Windows one before docker sees it.
body: MSYS path conversion rewrites any argument that looks like a POSIX path, so `docker run --rm img cat /etc/debian_version` reads `C:/Program Files/Git/etc/debian_version`, and `docker exec`, volume flags and container-side commands all suffer it. `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1` in front of the call is the whole fix; the tell is an error naming a path under `C:/Program Files/Git/` you never typed.
